event: Nala turns and sprints down the deer trail for the ford.
The scouts come shrieking after her, keeping their distance, calling her place to the file behind.

memory.fact: Alone, the scouts keep their distance, shrieking where she is, and close only once the file is up.

event: Slings whirr. She weaves. One stone hums past; another cracks off a yew.

memory.fact: A running slinger stops to loose only when the quarry is in plain sight within forty paces.

event: A third takes her high on the left shoulder. She stumbles, catches herself, and keeps running.

changes.note: A sling stone takes her high on the left shoulder

make.title: Bruised
make.description: A deep bruise high on the left shoulder, where a sling stone struck; it aches when the arm is lifted.

changes.note: The sling stone leaves her shoulder bruised

memory.fact: Running for the ford, Nala took a sling stone high on her left shoulder.
Running for the ford, Nala took a sling stone high on her left shoulder.

event: Her sense lays the trail out under her a stride ahead. The roar stays at her back.

changes.note: Her sense keeping the trail on the run raises Spatial Sense to LV 6
The level takes up the uses she carried

event: A mile and more. Her shoulder throbs; her breath burns. The trees thin.
She bursts out of the Tangle into the morning light and splashes into the ford, knee-deep.

memory.fact: Hot on a chase, the hunters follow their quarry out of the trees and into the ford.
Hot on a chase, the hunters follow their quarry out of the trees and into the ford.

event: Across the water, behind the drystone wall, Dace's shield rises. Merrit's hand is already glowing.
She scrambles up the bank and over the wall.

memory.fact: Nala crossed Tull's ford and got over the sheep wall to the Four, the hunters pouring out behind.
Nala crossed Tull's ford and got over the sheep wall to the Four, the hunters pouring out behind.

event: Behind her nine goblins pour out of the trees, shrieking, straight for the ford.

memory.fact: Nine goblins poured out of the Tangle after Nala, shrieking, straight for Tull's ford.
Nine goblins poured out of the Tangle after Nala, shrieking, straight for Tull's ford.

event: The hobgoblin with the maul shoulders to the front, bellowing, and wades in first.

memory.fact: A hobgoblin with a maul burst from the trees roaring and waded first into the ford.
A hobgoblin with a maul burst from the trees roaring and waded first into the ford.
At the treeline the hobgoblin shoulders to the front, roaring, and wades first into the ford.

As the band hits the water, the scouts hang back at the treeline, shrieking, not yet in the open.
